verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Devin producing an implementation plan for the developer to review and approve before it edits code. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: taking over in the IDE after a first draft is post-implementation review, a tool permission system is a different control, and AGENTS.md is read before coding but is not a plan-approval gate.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made
